notes.title: Developer Stream #5 - Re-Clash of Titans!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/a60384a670999565453b8619cd64ca245c74a396.png

Greetings Commanders!
Last week’s match with Jackson and Byron was so epic, we’re bringing Jackson back for a re-clash of the titans! This weekend he will be facing off against Ars Victor founder and creator Mike Bott. Two veteran strategic minds will meet on the battlefield again, and once more with live commentary! Ars Victor creator and developer Steve DeBaun will be breaking down the action, explaining the game, and providing analysis of the brilliant ploys and counter-attacks we’re bound to see this weekend.

Check out the match this Saturday, January 30th at 11AM PST. Join the chat from our Store Page and talk with the developers while we play. We’ll be there to answer all your questions about the game. See you on the battlefield Commander!


If you'd like to catch up on the Developer Stream series, including last week’s epic battle between two Ars Victor all-timers, all of our previous broadcasts are available on our YouTube channel:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/b9e9ece64bfcad7f8c4520f0ea5cf2bb16ba222b.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38749086/66ed0b8664b1ee66182903bde9e7789b059ac585.png

Do you think you have what it takes to be a successful commander? We’re looking for fresh recruits right now to take the battlefield! The game is in the early alpha stages and we need you to help us playtest the latest builds emerging from our developers cave. Play the most up-to-date versions of the game with the hottest features while also helping us stay on track for a spring Early Access release! First, join our Discord server and then follow the directions here to get started. See you on the battlefield, Commander!

notes.title: Developer Stream #3 - Happy New Year from Trip West Games!
notes.content:
Happy New Year Commanders! We hope you had a happy and healthy holiday season and are ready to welcome 2021 with us. This year will see the Early Access release of Ars Victor Digital! Improvements to basic gameplay, bug fixes, and minor design updates are being rolled out to alpha testers each week. Right now the big focus of the development team is on the new single-player campaign mode. Look for more screenshots and updates on that project over the next few weeks.

To kick the new year off we’re bringing you the third installment of the Developer Stream Series. This weekend will feature Lead Audio Engineer Jonathan DeBaun vs Producer Alyson Lowe. Tune into the Steam Store Page this Saturday, January 2nd at 11AM PST to watch the game, ask questions, and chat with the developers!


If you missed our previous developer stream with Lead Developer Zack Kirsch and Producer Alyson Lowe, you can watch it here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Om6p9Q40x6w
